newsitem.title: USA: PageNet, Arch lead paging sector.
newsitem.headline: PageNet, Arch lead paging sector.

text.p: Paging Network Inc and Arch Communications Group Inc should stand out this quarter as two leaders of the paging group with strong management and good financials, analysts said.
They said the sector's fourth-quarter results, expected to show overall moderate growth and closely match Wall Street's estimates, will help separate the strong from the weak.
"It is truly the management. Arch probably has the best management out there. PageNet really had a great vision a few years ago...to become nationwide," said Christopher Larsen of NatWest Securities.
